$description: Authoritative unit specification for all numeric parameters used in Energy Wallet model calculations (Steps 3-5). Skills that create or edit input files MUST reference this file to ensure values are in the correct units. Template patterns use {N} for vehicle slot (1,2) and {s} for config suffix (base,alt), matching required.py conventions.

electricity_fixed_charge_monthly.description: Monthly fixed electricity charge (annualized by multiplying by 12)

natural_gas_fixed_charge_monthly.description: Monthly fixed natural gas charge (annualized by multiplying by 12)

vehicle_{N}_efficiency_electric_{s}.description: Electric energy intensity per kilometre (converted to GJ in calculations via *0.0036)

ev_{N}_efficiency_factor_{s}.description: EV climate derating factor (<=1 increases consumption; energy divided by this factor)

ev_{N}_pct_charged_home_{s}.description: Fraction of EV charging done at home (0-1)

ev_{N}_pct_charged_level2_{s}.description: Fraction of EV charging done at public Level 2 (0-1)

ev_{N}_pct_charged_fast_{s}.description: Fraction of EV charging done at DCFC (0-1)

heating_load_annual_{s}.description: Total annual space heating load (delivered heat)

cooling_load_annual_{s}.description: Total annual space cooling load (delivered cooling)

heating_system_proportion_gas_{s}.description: Fraction of heating load served by natural gas (0-1)

heating_system_proportion_electric_{s}.description: Fraction of heating load served by electricity (0-1)

heating_system_proportion_oil_{s}.description: Fraction of heating load served by oil (0-1)

heating_system_proportion_propane_{s}.description: Fraction of heating load served by propane (0-1)

heating_system_proportion_wood_{s}.description: Fraction of heating load served by wood (0-1)

heating_system_efficiency_gas_{s}.description: Heating system efficiency for natural gas (AFUE or COP)

dhw_load_annual_{s}.description: Total annual domestic hot water load (delivered heat)

dhw_system_proportion_gas_{s}.description: Fraction of DHW load served by natural gas (0-1)

dhw_system_proportion_electric_{s}.description: Fraction of DHW load served by electricity (0-1)

dhw_system_proportion_oil_{s}.description: Fraction of DHW load served by oil (0-1)

dhw_system_proportion_propane_{s}.description: Fraction of DHW load served by propane (0-1)

dhw_system_proportion_wood_{s}.description: Fraction of DHW load served by wood (0-1)

dhw_system_efficiency_gas_{s}.description: DHW system efficiency for natural gas (energy factor or COP)

dhw_system_efficiency_electric_{s}.description: DHW system efficiency for electricity (energy factor or COP)

other_electricity_annual_{s}.description: Annual electricity for non-HVAC/DHW end-uses (appliances, lighting)

other_natural_gas_annual_{s}.description: Annual natural gas for non-HVAC/DHW end-uses (cooking)
